name: The Defector
objective: A former Krampus officer offers to trade the location of the fourth bell — for a fight. He wants to know if you are strong enough for what comes next.
intro: He removes his old insignia before he battles. He folds it neatly, sets it on a stump, and bows.
dialogue: Krampus Defector: "I marched under the skull. I know what the bell really does. Walk away."
Krampus Defector (defeated): "Fine. The vault. Under the shrine. But you won't like what you hear."
lore_discovery: The defector heard the Director's final bell from inside the Keep. He says it did not summon anything. It answered something.
